messages:
sam: Kicking off the region-by-region rollout this evening. Plan: US canary -> EU staggered -> APAC delayed by ~2h for cache warmup. Pinning service version v1.12.3 for this rollout. Canaries will be 1% traffic to start. Asking eng-sre for a quick capacity sanity (+ any hot-pool / warm-pool numbers).
jess: ack. I'll validate warm-pool counts and quota reservations now. sending numbers in 5.
maria: FYI change window: US 22:00-02:00 PDT, EU window 01:00-05:00 UTC, APAC 09:00-13:00 SGT (we'll delay APAC start into that window). No planned infra changes besides the deploy.
deploy-bot: @sam deploy initiated: env=prod region=us version=v1.12.3 slice=canary size=1%
deploy-bot: logs: canary rollout started, 12 instances registered, 8/12 healthy, continuing traffic shift
jess: Warm pool check (US): reserved GPUs=220 (warm), idle capacity=40, sustained throughput headroom ~18% at current token profile. Suggest reserve 30 GPUs for rollback buffer.
nate: Quick perf readout from synthetic smoke: p50=92ms, p95=280ms for canary slice. Error rate 0.3% (3xx/5xx combined). Looks good so far.
sam: Good. Let's hold 15 mins after canary before EU kickoff. Rollback triggers: error rate >2% for 5m OR p95 increase >2x baseline OR key route latency >300ms sustained 5m. If triggered, pin traffic back to v1.11-quant fallback automatically.
maria: Noted. Also adding regional circuit rule: if US consumes >60% of regional quota in first 30m, pause EU start and notify execs.
jess: EU warm-pool status: reserved GPUs=180, idle capacity=25. APAC warm-pool staging shows container images cached only on 40% of nodes; will do a preload wave before APAC start. ETA for preload 90m.
sam: Okay we delay APAC start until preload completes. EU can start after our 15m hold and a green perf check. Ops: please prepare rollback doc and the quick pin command in runbook.
nate: Prepared rollback snippet in runbook:
```
# emergency rollback
deploy-bot rollback --env prod --target-version v1.11-quant --regions <region>
# immediate pin traffic
deploy-bot pin --env prod --version v1.11-quant --scope regional
```
sam: Perfect. Also adding a soft-fallback route: if model latency breach occurs, route to low-latency variant in same version (v1.12.3-ll). That should keep UX while we investigate.
jess: Confirmed circuit config: fallback variant pre-warmed in US/EU, APAC will be preloaded during the delay.
deploy-bot: canary slice at 1% stable for 10m, health checks passing, no elevated errors.
maria: Observability notes: tracing hooks are enabled, token-level cost has spike guard on. If token cost per request jumps >1.5x baseline, we'll auto-throttle canary ramp.
sam: Decision: Proceed to EU canary in 15m. EU will start at 0.5% then ramp to 2% over 20m if healthy. APAC remain on hold until preload finishes. Anyone object?
jess: no objections. I'll monitor quotas and warm pools.
nate: I'll watch latency/error dashboards and set alert threshold to 3m aggregations for faster signal.
sam: Thanks. If anything odd, use the rollback snippet and drop a call in #incidents. I'll be on standby. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: eu rollout queued: env=prod region=eu slice=0.5% scheduled_ts=1789456890
maria: Preload started for APAC images, progress 20% -> 60% within 40m estimate. I'll post a final go/no-go when done.
jen (ops on-call): quick note — if any thermal/host eviction alerts fire, hold all ramps and escalate to infra.
sam: Good call. Closing loop: EU start in 15m, APAC delayed until preload + warm-pool >= 70% coverage. Will post final rollout status in 30m.
